Extremely disappointing experience.

I will never return to Van Aken Pet Hospital.
We had previously brought our rabbit here for dental work and other treatment and paid for those services, so we were already established customers.

About six months ago, we brought our dog in for an evaluation. The veterinarian, who is also the owner of the practice, gave us an estimate for treatment that was simply far beyond what we could afford.
I apologized and explained that unfortunately we could not proceed because of the cost.
The owner/veterinarian told us, “No worries,” and specifically told us that we did not have to pay for that visit since we were not going forward with the treatment.

We thanked her and walked directly out through reception in front of the staff. Nobody stopped us, asked us for payment, or said that we owed anything. We left believing the matter was completely settled because the owner herself had told us not to pay.

Approximately six months later, I called to bring my rabbit back for treatment. Suddenly I was told that they would no longer see us because we supposedly “left without paying.”
The person telling me this was the manager, who is the veterinarian/owner's husband. I explained what had happened and told him that his wife was the person who personally told us that we did not have to pay.

I asked him to simply speak with her and verify it.
Instead of trying to resolve what appears to be an internal communication or record-keeping problem, he was extremely rude and dismissive and told me they would no longer do business with us.

Think about that: the owner of the practice tells a customer not to pay a particular visit, the customer walks out openly through reception, nobody asks for payment, and six months later the customer's character is questioned for supposedly leaving without paying. Then, rather than checking with the very veterinarian who waived the charge, the manager treats the customer rudely and refuses future care.

If the veterinarian forgot what she told us or failed to document it, that is an internal problem at their practice. It does not turn us into people who walked out on a bill.

And unfortunately, this experience reinforced something else I had already felt while dealing with this practice: they seem to care far more about money than about the animals.

Of course veterinarians deserve to be paid. But based on our experience, if you cannot afford every dollar of what they quote you, don't expect much compassion or flexibility. The animal simply isn't getting the treatment.

When a pet owner is facing an astronomical veterinary estimate, compassion matters. We weren't asking for free surgery. We simply couldn't afford what they quoted us. Yet months later we were treated as though we had done something dishonest, despite following the owner's own instructions
.
After trusting this practice with both our rabbit and our dog, I found the way we were treated by the manager particularly disrespectful and completely unprofessional.
I will never bring another animal here. If you choose to use this practice, get absolutely EVERYTHING regarding prices, waived charges, and payment arrangements in writing. Based on our experience, I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

After reading Rei and Crystal's review, I felt the need to write my own.

When I came to this clinic to get my animals seen, one of the technicians spoke about neutering and when I expressed my feelings on how I don't believe in doing that to my pets, she brought up "cancer" as if refusing to castrate my cat is poor judgment on my part when it's not. I and others have a right to say no to the mind control that is dominant in the veterinary services industry.

When I inquired about a special quote that involves flying my animals out of the country, the doctor or her husband never got back to me on that information. They also didn't answer my email I sent out because according to the receptionist, they don't respond to emails. Once I did call in and inquired about the quote they never got back to me on, I was told due to "staffing & prices" is why they won't be able to do the lengthy process it takes to go out of the country with an animal even though this clinic is supposedly certified to do such business. It really just sounded like they didn't want to do their job for whatever reason... but perhaps it's for the best that I don't return to this place considering that they can be unprofessional as Crystal pointed out in her review.

Also, I was told the same day they would email me/call me back with some info about going through some 3rd parties and of course that never happened since their office is closed now. So yeah, it's pretty sad how a lot of vet hospitals are terrible in the Phoenix city of Arizona.
